sources.name: GLA Circular Economy Statement Guidance
sources.fact: London guidance prioritises retention, reuse, adaptability and reporting of material/waste outcomes for relevant developments

sources.name: DEFRA circular economy guidance for mayoral strategic authorities
sources.fact: 2026 guidance supports circularity in growth plans and spatial strategies

sources.name: GLA waste model update 2026
sources.fact: GLA updated London waste-arising forecasts and borough apportionment evidence for the new London Plan

sources.name: GLA waste and recycling
sources.fact: London policy aims to reduce waste, increase reuse/recycling and manage residual waste more sustainably

sources.name: U1 waste exemption construction
sources.fact: Updated 22 July 2026 guidance defines conditional use of specified waste in construction and does not create a blanket exemption

sources.name: SR2022 No 3 CDE waste transfer station
sources.fact: May 2026 standard rules govern qualifying construction/demolition/excavation waste transfer operations

sources.name: Waste environmental permits
sources.fact: Waste treatment, storage and disposal can require standard or bespoke environmental permits

sources.name: Waste recovery plans
sources.fact: May 2026 recovery guidance requires evidence that deposit is genuinely recovery and risk controls are appropriate

sources.name: London Infrastructure Framework
sources.fact: Waste is included as a strategic infrastructure sector needed to support London growth

sources.name: London Strategic Infrastructure Requirements
sources.fact: Strategic requirements evidence considers waste infrastructure alongside other growth systems

sources.name: Draft London Plan 2026 greener resilient city
sources.fact: July 2026 draft includes strategic environmental policies; draft status is retained

sources.name: LBBD Local Plan 2037
sources.fact: Adopted Local Plan is the borough decision-making starting point and infrastructure context

examples: Circular Economy Statement requirement is scheme/threshold dependent and does not prove a project is compliant
Waste-arising forecast is strategic evidence, not parcel waste quantity
U1 exemption requires conditions and limits; it is not automatic permission to use waste
Standard rules permit only applies when an operation fits the rule set
Recycling target or circularity policy does not quantify demolition recovery at a candidate site
Retention/reuse opportunity needs building/material survey evidence
Waste infrastructure need does not prove local facility capacity or acceptance
No cost or value uplift is assigned from circular-economy policy without scheme material quantities and disposal/reuse evidence
